# User Account Entity Type

Represents a user's account on an external provider (e.g. GitHub). Used by the AI spend tracker to discover which provider accounts exist so usage metrics can be fetched.

## Properties

- **provider** (required): Provider base URL (e.g. `https://github.com`).
- **user-name** (required): The account username on this provider.

## Naming convention

User-account entities live under a `user` entity and are named:
```
["users", "username", "<username>", "user-accounts", "<provider-hostname>"]
```
For example: `["users", "username", "jrowe", "user-accounts", "github.com"]`
